The main takeaway from our work is that
the reduced ability of MgATP analogs to stimulate channel activity does not result from a reduction in ATPase activity.
the actions of ATP analogues on the SUR1 subunit of KATP channels are not as straightforward as previously assumed, and that their effects require reinterpretation.
